technical-summary: pin-bump's _commit_release_records staged releases/<target_ref>.json, but the record writer names records by records.release_key (the pinned tag, else the 12-hex commit prefix). For an untagged commit pin the record file stayed untracked and the lane build refused the dirty tree. It now commits releases/<key>.json and <key>-patches.md with the same key.
user-summary-candidate: A radiance bump to an untagged upstream commit commits its own release record and proceeds to the lane build.
